title.zh: Brazil’s Stock Market Crashes After Lula’s Upset Victory
title.en: Brazil’s Stock Market Crashes After Lula’s Upset Victory

current_state.zh: Brazilian stocks shed more than $200 billion and the iShares MSCI Brazil ETF (EWZ) plunged as much as 26% after Lula defeated Flávio Bolsonaro in a runoff that Polymarket and Kalshi had priced as an ~80% Bolsonaro win, with the real sliding up to 12% and B3 triggering its first circuit breaker since the pandemic.

updates.title_zh: 卢拉意外获胜后巴西股市暴跌
updates.title_en: Brazil’s Stock Market Crashes After Lula’s Upset Victory
updates.what_changed_zh:
周日决选投票中，总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦以51.79%对48.21%击败参议员弗拉维奥·博索纳罗，周一开盘巴西股市市值蒸发逾2000亿美元。iShares MSCI Brazil ETF（EWZ）从周五约42.60美元的收盘价最低跌至31.40美元，跌幅达26%；美元兑雷亚尔一度上涨12%；圣保罗交易所B3触发30分钟熔断，为新冠疫情以来首次。

这一结果与预测市场Polymarket和Kalshi的定价相悖——投票前一天两家平台给博索纳罗开出的胜率接近80%。博索纳罗周日晚表示不承认选举结果，将请求法院宣布选举无效，使政治不确定性在市场开盘之外继续延烧。

Ibovespa指数最低下跌17%至约170000点，跌幅触及10%后触发暂停交易，30分钟熔断结束后继续走低；对以美元计价的投资者而言，汇率与指数跌幅叠加，最差时合计损失约26%。据巴西最高选举法院，卢拉领先约440万票；而Datafolha最新民调显示，有效票中双方各为50%。

updates.detailed_summary_en: Brazilian stocks shed more than $200 billion and the iShares MSCI Brazil ETF (EWZ) plunged as much as 26% after Lula defeated Flávio Bolsonaro in a runoff that Polymarket and Kalshi had priced as an ~80% Bolsonaro win, with the real sliding up to 12% and B3 triggering its first circuit breaker since the pandemic.
updates.background_zh: 自博索纳罗在10月4日首轮投票中以47.03%对45.16%意外领先以来，投资者一直在为相反的结果布局：次日Ibovespa上涨7.85%，EWZ涨超10%，押注博索纳罗将收紧财政并为降息铺路。周一的暴跌抹去了这轮涨势，低点时Ibovespa较10月2日收盘低约11%。Polymarket是加密预测市场，Kalshi是受监管的事件合约交易所，当交易者隐含80%概率时，胜选后支付1美元的合约价格约为80美分。博索纳罗反对最高法院法官克里斯蒂亚诺·扎宁应卢拉竞选团队请求将投票延长至晚7点的决定，尽管其本人阵营也曾要求在三个州的部分地区延长投票时间。
updates.background_en: Investors had positioned for the opposite outcome since Bolsonaro unexpectedly finished first in the Oct. 4 first round with 47.03% of valid votes to Lula’s 45.16%; the Ibovespa rose 7.85% the next day and EWZ gained more than 10% on bets that Bolsonaro would tighten public finances and open the way to lower interest rates. Monday’s drop erased that rally and at its lows left the Ibovespa about 11% below its Oct. 2 close. Polymarket is a crypto-based prediction market and Kalshi a regulated event-contract exchange, where a contract paying $1 on a win trades near 80 cents when traders imply an 80% probability. Bolsonaro objected to Supreme Court Justice Cristiano Zanin’s decision to extend voting until 7 p.m. at Lula’s campaign’s request, though his own campaign had separately sought extra voting time in parts of three states.
updates.market_impact_zh: 这一冲击主要通过新兴市场货币压力传导至加密市场：雷亚尔兑美元一度下跌12%，会推高当地对美元计价资产的需求，这一渠道在巴西历来会带动稳定币与离岸加密活动；同时，主要新兴市场股票ETF单日26%的回撤也压制整体风险偏好。事件还把焦点投向与加密相关的预测市场——Polymarket给落败一方定价约80%，这可能影响事件合约的信心与成交，而非任何代币的基本面。
updates.market_impact_en: The shock transmits to crypto mainly through emerging-market currency stress: a real that fell as much as 12% against the dollar raises local demand for dollar-denominated assets, a channel that in Brazil has historically fed stablecoin and offshore-crypto activity, while a 26% single-day drawdown in a major EM equity ETF pressures broader risk appetite. The event also puts a spotlight on crypto-linked prediction markets, since Polymarket priced the losing side at roughly 80%, a framing that may affect confidence and volumes in event contracts rather than any token’s fundamentals.
